description: This file defines an interface for all Thing-related events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes nested classes for JSON field definitions used in event serialization and provides default method implementations related to event properties.

classes.name: ThingEvent
classes.description: An interface representing all events related to 'Thing' entities in Eclipse Ditto, parameterized with the implementing class type.

classes.name: ThingEvent.JsonFields
classes.description: A final static class containing JSON field definitions for 'Thing' events, such as 'thingId', 'featureId', and 'thing'.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity associated with the event, defaulting to getThingEntityId().

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, which is 'thing' for Thing-related events.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets DittoHeaders on the event, returning the modified event.
